study type: Probability analysis of historical control data
exposure: Rabbit strain (New Zealand White, Dutch Belted)
cohort: Pregnant New Zealand White and Dutch Belted rabbits from Covance and Charles River, whose historical control data from embryo-fetal development studies were analyzed.
finding: Pregnancy parameters and fetal observations significantly differ between rabbit strains and between sources of rabbits of the same strain, leading to drastically different probabilities of certain observations occurring by chance.
